name: Snip
description_en:
Snip is a product in the Note taking category. Its directory profile covers Recurring Tasks, To-do List, Calendar Notification, File Sharing, Real-time Collaboration, Templates, Version Control.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: make files available to authorized participants; reuse predefined layouts or workflow structures; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
